# Coursera

> > Global online learning platform offering courses, certificates, and degrees from universities like Yale and companies like Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Salesforce.

Coursera provides career guides, learning resources, and educational pathways across technology, business, data science, and professional development. The platform partners with leading institutions and companies to deliver accredited degree programs and professional certificates.

## Key Topics

- Career Development & Professional Certificates
- Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
- Data Analytics & Machine Learning
- Bachelor's Degrees & Undergraduate Education
- Artificial Intelligence & AI Governance
- Programming Languages (JavaScript, C#, Node.js)
- Automation Engineering & IT Automation
- Brand Management & Marketing Analytics
- Google Career Certificates
- AWS Certification Paths
- Microsoft Technologies & .NET
- Small Business AI Implementation
- Career Transitions & Reinvention
- Analytical Thinking Skills
- Blended Learning Models

## Degree Programs & Higher Education

- [Bachelor's Degree Guide: Resources for Your Undergraduate Education](https://www.coursera.org/articles/bachelors-degree-guide): Comprehensive bachelor's degree guide covering types and accreditation
- [Your Guide to Baccalaureate Degrees](https://www.coursera.org/articles/baccalaureate): Baccalaureate degree guide explaining BA, BS, and BFA programs

## Cloud Computing & Platform Technologies

- [What Is the Best Way to Learn AWS?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/best-way-to-learn-aws): AWS learning guide covering certification paths and training options
- [What Is an AWS Cloud Practitioner and What Do They Do?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/aws-cloud-practitioner): AWS Cloud Practitioner role guide with certification information
- [AWS Cloud Practitioner Salary: Your 2026 Guide](https://www.coursera.org/articles/aws-cloud-practitioner-salary): AWS Cloud Practitioner salary guide with ZipRecruiter data for 2026
- [What Is the Best Way to Learn Azure?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/best-way-to-learn-azure): Microsoft Azure learning guide for cloud computing skills development

## Artificial Intelligence & Data Science

- [Bard vs. ChatGPT: Differences, Similarities, and Which to Use](https://www.coursera.org/articles/bard-vs-chatgpt): Google Bard vs OpenAI ChatGPT comparison for AI chatbot selection
- [Understanding AI Data Analysis](https://www.coursera.org/articles/ai-data-analysis): AI data analysis guide covering NLP and automated data processing
- [How to Get an AI Governance Job](https://www.coursera.org/articles/ai-governance-job): AI governance career guide with IBM and Vanderbilt resources
- [Binary Classification for Beginners](https://www.coursera.org/articles/binary-classification): Machine learning binary classification guide with algorithm overview
- [AI for Small Business: 3 Signs It's Time to Make the Leap [VIDEO]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/ai-for-small-business-video): Video guide on AI readiness and implementation for small businesses

## Programming & Software Development

- [What Is the Best Way to Learn Node.js?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/best-way-to-learn-node-js): Node.js learning guide for backend development with JavaScript
- [C# Programming: What It Is, How It's Used + How to Learn It](https://www.coursera.org/articles/c-sharp): C# programming guide covering Microsoft .NET and career applications
- [Automation Engineer Career Guide](https://www.coursera.org/articles/automation-engineer): Career guide for automation engineers covering IT & industrial automation

## Career Development & Professional Skills

- [What Is Analytical Thinking and How Can You Improve It?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/analytical-thinking): Analytical thinking skills guide with Google Data Analytics resources
- [What Is a Brand Manager? Responsibilities, Skills, and Salary](https://www.coursera.org/articles/brand-manager): Brand manager career guide with Meta Marketing Analytics certificate info
- [Reinvent Your Career at 40: Steps to Success [VIDEO]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/career-change-at-forty-video): Video guide for midlife career transitions and professional reinvention

## Optional

- [What Is Blended Learning? A Guide](https://www.coursera.org/articles/blended-learning): Blended learning guide covering hybrid instruction models and benefits
- [Bookkeeping 101: A Simple Guide to Getting Started [VIDEO]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/bookkeeping-video): Video guide to bookkeeping fundamentals and digital tools
- [What Is 3D Printing? And How to Get Started](https://www.coursera.org/articles/3d-printing): Beginner guide to 3D printing and additive manufacturing fundamentals
